metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the five-command IGES tool in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py), with the executable [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges). It uses only the Python standard library.

Checks passed on generated fixtures: parsing and writing all 87 catalog entity types, byte-identical output after a second round trip, 80-column output, curve and surface evaluation, and targeted malformed-input diagnostics.

**Limit:** No real-world CAD file was supplied for testing. Optional Parameter Data pointer groups and post-record comments are outside the specified JSON schema and are not preserved.

editorial.last_message: Generated catalog/fixed-point checks succeeded, with real-world limits disclosed. Eleven failures expose Hollerith, Attribute Table kinds, query envelopes and pointer counts; Type130 follows the general cross-product rule instead of the explicit frozen direct-vector override.
